answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in cedar, checked in pigment, and willow reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2197 identities would post 1690 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
